meta.name: The Seventh Sign
meta.description: Abby is a pregnant woman with a curious new boarder in the apartment over her garage. Turns out he's heaven-sent and is speeding along the Apocalypse by bloodying rivers, egging on plagues and following scripture word for word.
meta.slogan: It was foretold there will be seven signs. The seventh sign will be a woman. Her hope is all we have left.
